name: Cross-Reference Agreement Memory
scientific_question: In K-shot pooled memory bank anomaly detection (A1), every test patch is scored by its single smallest distance over ALL reference patches (from all K reference images pooled). A single accidentally-similar reference patch can mask a defect. Question: for real defects, is the test patch far from EVERY normal reference image, while normal variation is only far from SOME references? If so, cross-reference agreement (median distance across reference images, gap to the lucky minimum, reference disagreement MAD) carries signal.

data.categories: all 6 (bracket_black, bracket_brown, bracket_white, connector, metal_plate, tubes)
data.ref_per_image: ref_patch_features axis 0 == K (one block per reference IMAGE); per-image attribution verified

features.fused_space: exact A1 concat: per-patch L2-normalize each branch, concat with dino_weight=0.5 clip_weight=0.5 (clip bilinear-resized to dino grid 32x32), then faiss.normalize_L2 over flattened fused patch rows
features.per_ref_distance: d_r(q) = min_j [ L2^2(q, p_{r,j}) / 2 ]  for reference image r, i.e. min over patches of image r only; == 1 - cos to best patch of image r
features.pooled_equiv: d_min = min_r d_r == A1 pooled-NN distance (min over pooled patches)

candidates.A0_identity: score = d_min  (MUST replay A1 fused map; max|diff| <= 1e-6)
candidates.A1_median_gap: score = d_min + 0.5 * max(0, d_med - d_min),  d_med = median_r d_r
candidates.A2_mad_calibrated: score = d_min * (1 + 0.5 * clip(mad_r / mad95_normal, 0, 1)),  mad_r = MAD_r(d_r) = median_r |d_r - median_r(d_r)|

normal_calibration_A2.procedure: for each ref image r: build bank from the other K-1 ref images (fused per-image blocks), treat ref r patches as pseudo-queries, compute d_r' over the K-1 remaining ref images -> per-patch MAD_r ; aggregate over all r and all normal ref patches
normal_calibration_A2.statistic: mad95_normal = 95th percentile of the aggregated per-patch normal MAD distribution (scalar per category); no test images, no test stats, no GT
normal_calibration_A2.k1_note: k=1 strictly returns A0 (no cross-ref quantity exists)

gates.g1: identity replay A0 vs A1 frozen fused map max|diff| <= 1e-6
gates.g2: mean Pixel-AP gain over A0 (both shots k2+k4 averaged) >= +0.005
gates.g3: at least 4/6 categories positive on average (across k2,k4)
gates.g5: Pixel-AUROC mean loss >= -0.002 (i.e. not worse than -0.002)
gates.g6: real references beat shuffled-reference control by >= +0.002 (candidate mean gain under real refs - shuffled control gain)
gates.note: if only k4 passes and k2 fails, route survives ONLY as a multi-reference module, cannot claim 1/2/4-shot coverage

strong_controls.c1_duplicate_refs: repeat the same reference image(s) to inflate K; A0 AP must be unchanged (duplicates add no new bank vectors) and candidate gains must not spuriously increase
strong_controls.c2_shuffled_refs: shuffle patch blocks across reference images (pool preserved, image attribution destroyed); consistency gains must disappear
strong_controls.c3_med_only: A1(candidate) must beat a plain median aggregator (score=d_med) to show gain is not just a new pooling op

metric_protocol: STRIDE=8 strided pixel AUROC/AP/AUPRO over gt masks at 448 (dino grid mask), aupro_fast steps=200; maps via dists2map (bilinear) to 448x448
leakage: no gt_masks/gt_labels in scoring path; calibration from reference images only; method signature never takes gt fields; 'change GT -> same maps' test included
